bootstrap_architecture.stage1: System update, operator creation, explicit public-key installation, scoped sudoers, Docker CE installation, fail2ban, UFW baseline, candidate SSH config
bootstrap_architecture.stage2: Enforce PermitRootLogin no, PasswordAuthentication no, sshd -t syntax test, reload sshd (executed ONLY after operator SSH login proof)
bootstrap_architecture.verify: Independent post-bootstrap check of OS, accounts, sudoers, sshd, Docker, fail2ban, Chrony, UFW, and forbidden ports

operator_privilege_and_auth_model.sudo_model: SCOPED_COMMAND_ALIASES (CYBRIK_INFRA = systemctl, service, ufw, docker, apt-get, journalctl)

threat_model_disclosure.rationale: Docker socket access (/var/run/docker.sock) grants root-equivalent control over the host via container management. This is documented transparently.

ssh_hardening_controls.PermitRootLogin: no (Applied in Stage 2 after login proof)
ssh_hardening_controls.lockout_guard: Syntax test sshd -t executed before reload; automated rollback on failure

userns-remap.justification: User namespace remapping conflicts with PostgreSQL 16 and Valkey 8 persistent volume UID/GID ownership. Security isolation is achieved via non-root container processes and dedicated internal Docker networks.

network_firewall_and_bypass_protection.enforcement: Dual-layer: UFW packet filtering + Docker internal bridge isolation (zero host port publications for data/app containers)

services_and_observability.logrotate: Configured for host and container logs
